entries.zh: 土坑，地里挖的洞穴（堀）；坑
entries.en: hole or pit dug in the ground; pit, excavation
hole in the ground; burrow, cavity

entries.zh: 土中的孔穴与缝隙（穴隙）
entries.en: hole in the earth; hole or crevice, gap

entries.zh: 地下洞穴、坑道（竇陷）；亦指攻城地道（contramina，反坑道/地道）
entries.en: holes in the ground, hollows; mine or countermine, subterranean passage

entries.zh: 封门，封堵门户；（西语词头谓门锁之孔/锁孔，与汉字栏不合）
entries.en: keyhole, hole of the lock; hole for barring or sealing the door
entries.notes: 汉字栏作“封門”（封门），与西语 agujero de la cerradura（锁孔）语义不合，或指门闩封门之孔，依赖推断。

entries.zh: 葱管，葱茎的中空管；泛指茎秆（苇、蔗秆）内的空心
entries.en: hollow tube of a scallion stalk; hole in a reed or stalk, hollow of a bulb
entries.notes: 西语 cebolla（洋葱）与汉字栏“蔥”（葱）所指略有出入，取植物茎管中空义对应。

entries.zh: 漏孔，滴水滴漏穿成的孔（漏空）
entries.en: hole made by a leak or dripping water; leak hole

entries.zh: 端正、合式（着势；谓孔洞打得端正恰当）
entries.en: straight, proper hole; right and fitting
entries.notes: “着勢”（tio̍h-sì）义为恰当合适，与西语 derecho（端正/笔直）对应较弱，依赖推断。

entries.zh: 打成孔，打凿而使成孔（打成空）
entries.en: hole, and making it; to beat or strike into a hole
to gouge out, hollow out; to bore
to bore a hole, gouge out a hole
to gouge out a hole, hollow out a hole

entries.zh: 啄石成孔，凿钻石头使成孔（啄成空）
entries.en: to bore or drill a hole in stone; to peck/chisel stone into a hole

entries.zh: 钻一个孔，凿成一个孔（托一空）
entries.en: to bore one hole, make a single hole
entries.notes: 首字“托”（thok）与西语 agujerear 的对应依赖推断，或为凿钻类动词的记音用字。

entries.en: to chisel a hole, bore with a chisel
